title: Invertible degree-zero stalk component from residue homology
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $a:\mathcal O_S[0]\to E$, and $s\in U$ for an open $U$. Let $P$ be strictly perfect on the localized module site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with $P^i=0$ for $i<0$ and $P^0\simeq\mathcal O_U$. Fix $e:E|_U\simeq Q(P)$. Let $A$ be the single complex on the restriction of $\mathcal O_S$ in degree zero, fix $c:(\mathcal O_S[0])|_U\simeq Q(A)$, and fix a chain map $\alpha:A\to P$ with $Q(\alpha)=c^{-1}\circ(a|_U)\circ e$. Assume $H^0(Li_s^*a)$ is invertible, where $i_s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ and derived pullback are as in [def-pc-base-change] and [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then the additive stalk map of the component $\alpha^0$, under the canonical localized module stalk functor [lem-sc-localized-homology-stalk-comparison], is an isomorphism. No assertion about the original homology stalk map is included.

proof.text: Identify the localized module site with the open subscheme. The finite-projective terms of P are flat, and its finite support makes it bounded above. Apply [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback] to compute residue pullback termwise. Derived pullback composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] identifies the residue of the representing equality with the residue of a, conjugated by the residue images of c and e. These are isomorphisms, so the residue homology arrow of alpha is invertible.

Since negative terms vanish, residue degree-zero homology of P is the kernel of its outgoing differential, without incoming boundaries. The generator of the residue source has nonzero homology image under the invertible residue arrow, hence alpha^0 sends it to a nonzero vector in the rank-one degree-zero residue term.

Choose rank-one bases of the source and target stalks. The component is multiplication by a scalar with nonzero residue. IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit makes this scalar a unit. Multiplication by the inverse unit constructs a linear inverse; forgetting scalars gives the claimed additive isomorphism.

theorem isIso_localized_stalk_component_of_residue_homology (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : S.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S)
    (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ E) (s : S)
    (U : S.Opens) (hs : s ∈ U)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect S U P)
    (hnegative : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (P.X i))
    (hzero : Nonempty (P.X 0 ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin 1))))
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    (ha : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map a)))
    (c : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
              (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf))))
    (α : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).obj (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶ P)
    (hα : DerivedCategory.Q.map α = c.inv ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫
        e.hom) :
    IsIso ((localizedModuleStalk S U ⟨s, hs⟩).map (α.f 0))
